description:
You are a cartographer preparing a base layer for a web mapping project. The current gvSIG project contains a world countries view in WGS 84 geographic coordinates (EPSG:4326), but you need to change the view's Coordinate Reference System (CRS) to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) for compatibility with standard web tile services.

Starting state: gvSIG Desktop is open with the 'countries_base' project loaded. The Project Manager window should be visible. The project has a view named 'View' (or similar) containing the Natural Earth 110m countries shapefile.

Your tasks:
1. Open the view (double-click it in the Project Manager if not already open).
2. Access the View Properties dialog. You can do this via the 'View' menu > 'Properties', or by right-clicking the view name in the Project Manager.
3. In the View Properties, locate the Current Projection/CRS setting (currently EPSG:4326).
4. Change the view's CRS to EPSG:3857 (often listed as 'WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator' or 'Popular Visualisation CRS / Mercator'). Use the search feature in the CRS selector to find code 3857.
5. Confirm the CRS selection and close the properties dialog. The map may distort significantly (Greenland appearing larger) - this is expected for Mercator.
6. Save the project as a new file: /home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/mercator_project.gvsproj

Verification will check the saved project file to ensure the View CRS is correctly set to EPSG:3857.
